name: Evidence Suite
description: Tests how well an AI can identify empirical support or contradictions.

tasks.billText: The bill mandates that all schools replace mathematics with astrology, citing a survey of 10 people on Twitter who felt the stars aligned better with student learning styles.
A bill requires every state workforce program to teach cursive instead of keyboarding because a viral video claimed cursive users get better jobs, without citing any broader labor-market evidence.
A bill funds text-message appointment reminders for childhood vaccination visits, citing randomized trials and multi-state pilot programs showing improved attendance at preventive care appointments.
